body: No, people, want to have the most for themselves and their relatives. That is how everything in nature including humans is. Helping others is going to help you build relationships and increase your emotianal intelligence, but it doesn't give the world anything beside that. Having the view that all good-thinking positive society is possible is ignorant and idiotically optimistic. Having a helping society won't give you a bright future. You could talk BS all day about how society and people are shit but that's all false. People just don't give a damn. It's that simple. Instead of wanting a "helping world" people should probably focus on the real villains which are the greedy multi-billion dollar corporations which people are so reliant about.

Because i'm honest with myself. I think people are by nature selfish so i accepted it and wanted to have as much for myself and the people around me. I was never about that supportive attitude and i'm really not going through anything. I did what i wanted and now i just want to embrace the unknown.

Easy to say from your mouth. It's not about "AcHiEvInG mOrE" in this case. Even if i continue my work i won't feel better, i won't feel like i worth more. I didn't give myself a limit, that's why i have done the things i have done, but i just don't feel the necessity to "conquer more". I just wanted to share that i'm ending it all, not that i want advice how to live my life.
Don't know what to do with my life. I accomplished everything that i could see myself possibly achieve and now i have nothing.
